stop_condition: 仅核心正确性、安全、权限、数据完整性、资源、法律、成本或不可逆风险
steps: run deterministic package and target acceptance
write PASS/CONDITIONAL PASS/FAIL without changing acceptance
risks_addressed: subject drift between test and release
rollback: preserve failed receipt and exact hashes

seal_procedure.why_two_runs: the seal asserts that the working tree is clean, and a report written into that tree makes it dirty. A node cannot hash the tree that will contain its own hash.
seal_procedure.run_1: executed at HEAD 166ccef0bbe434757a5a819ef50cb68fa1188515 before this node's artefacts were committed; produces the acceptance ledger and the verdict, and is stored as validation-report.json. Its ac001.working_tree_is_clean check FAILS by construction, because this node's own uncommitted files are present.
seal_procedure.run_2: executed after the closure commit, against the clean sealed tree; stored as docs/evidence/PG-8/seal-confirmation.json. This is the run whose exact commit and tree identify the sealed Subject.
seal_procedure.no_check_was_relaxed: the clean-tree check is not weakened or skipped in either run; run 1 records it as a genuine FAIL and run 2 records the real result on the sealed tree.
